reserveReview.rationale: The issuer API reports 34,938.881009 USDU-equivalent in the Morpho adapter and 22,684.146395 in the Curve adapter, with negligible TermMax backing. At Ethereum block 25530488, the Curve pool held 30,869.816267 USDC and 19,226.470521 USDU. Splitting the API-valued Curve position by those constituent balances and normalizing to total backing yields 60.6% Morpho USDU self-exposure, 15.1% Curve USDU self-exposure, and 24.3% external USDC collateral. The live API remains the source of the adapter totals; the pool split is an on-chain constituent classification rather than a supply override.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: USDU issuer backing API with an on-chain constituent split of the Curve LP position
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All positive adapter backing is classified; USDU-denominated vault and LP positions are retained as self-reserve rather than false upstream dependencies.
